title: Submodules of localized modules come from submodules before localization
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $S\subseteq R$ a multiplicative subset, $M$ an $R$-module, and $N$ a submodule of the localized module $S^{-1}M$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. Let $L$ be the inverse image of $N$ under the localization map $M\to S^{-1}M$. Then $N$ is the localization $S^{-1}L$ of $L$ inside $S^{-1}M$.
